title: Walk the house together
body: A free 45-minute walkthrough, in person or on video. We note water shutoffs, the breaker panel, alarm codes and the quirks only you know about.

title: We write your checklist
body: Your plan gets a checklist built for your house, plus agreed access, emergency contacts and the local trades you trust.

title: Visits start
body: We show up on schedule and send a photo report after every visit. If something is wrong, you hear from us right away, not at the end of the month.
